results.title: Trump's Popularity Is Circling the Drain

results.content:
A new Economist/YouGov poll released Sept. 22 found Trump's approval rating fell five points in a single week, from 40% to 35%, wiping out five straight weeks of gains in the same poll. The drop leaves him just two points above the lowest rating he's ever recorded in the survey and comes as Republicans enter the final stretch before November's midterm elections. [...] According to the poll, only 32% of Americans approved of Trump's job performance, a three-point drop from the previous edition of the same poll.

results.title: Trump approval rating sinks as Dems lead by double digits

results.content:
The latest Economist/YouGov poll surveyed 1,592 U.S. adult citizens from August 28 to 31, 2026. Its overall sample had a margin of error of 3.5 percentage points.

Respondents were asked whether they approved or disapproved of the way Trump was handling his job as president. Among those aged 30 to 44, the 27 percent approval figure was outweighed by 70 percent disapproval. [...] National opinion also moved against the president, but less sharply.

His overall net rating shifted from positive 6 in January 2025 to negative 24 in the latest survey, a 30-point decline compared with the 42-point fall among 30- to 44-year-olds.
